description: This header file defines the interface for mounting a root filesystem image in the omi namespace. It declares the DoMount function, which mounts an image filesystem given a mounter object, container ID, filesystem image path, config JSON path, and outputs the decrypted config payload and error message.

classes.name: omi::ImageMounter
classes.description: An external class representing an image mounter object used for mounting filesystem images.

methods.name: DoMount
methods.description: Function to mount a filesystem image, returning 0 on success and -1 on failure. It takes references to an ImageMounter object, container ID, paths, and outputs for payload and error message.
